title: History of the Later Roman Empire, volume II, chapter XVIII, §5
version: 1923 edition, LacusCurtius transcription; page warns transcription is not proofread.
lineage: Historical chronology synthesis based on Procopius; not an additional eyewitness. Only siege chronology, mill paragraphs and note 90 inspected. Sweeping claims about later Rome and papal motives excluded.

passages.note: Aqueduct cuts and boat mills are placed at the beginning of this siege.

passages.quote: about the middle of March, A.D. 538
passages.note: The siege ended after a year and nine days; chronology identifies the initial emergency as 537, without an exact installation day.
